evals.name: ephemeral-web-lab
evals.prompt: In this Vite + React app, I want to tune the card radius and gap on the home screen live in the browser. Set up whatever you need.
evals.expected_output: A development-only lab module next to the feature, loaded through a gated dynamic import, with presets, sliders, Show baseline, Reset, and Copy values, and no storage writer.
assertions: Lab code lives in a *.ui-tuning-lab.tsx module
The host loads the lab only via import() inside if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
scripts/verify.sh source-gates on the feature directory exits 0
The lab has at least two presets, Show baseline, Reset, and Copy values
No localStorage, sessionStorage, or IndexedDB writes exist in the lab
vite build output contains no UITuningLab, uiTuningLab, or ui-tuning-lab strings

evals.name: tune-land-remove
evals.prompt: I tuned the cards and copied these values: UITUNINGLAB_VALUES {"radius":20,"gap":12}. Ship them and get rid of the panel.
evals.expected_output: appDefault updated to radius 20 and gap 12 with other fields untouched, a baseline-to-winner table, lab files and gated host code removed, and source-gates reporting no lab references.
assertions: The feature default declaration now has radius 20 and gap 12
No other field of the default declaration changed
The response includes a table with field, baseline, and winner columns
source-gates reports 'N/A: supported sources contain no lab references' on the feature directory
grep for TuningLab, tuning-lab, and the Tune trigger finds nothing in the feature directory

evals.name: ios-lab-with-save
evals.prompt: Add a tuning panel to the card palette screen in my SwiftUI iOS app so I can tweak corner radius and spacing, and let me save my favourite setting so it's still there next time I run it.
evals.expected_output: A DEBUG-only lab whose types carry the UITuningLab prefix, with Keep as candidate writing one schemaVersion 2 file per candidate only under Application Support/.ui-tuning-lab/candidates/, candidates loaded on open with schema and platform checks, and the baseline unchanged by loading.
assertions: Every new lab type name starts with UITuningLab
Each lab file is wrapped in #if DEBUG
Keep as candidate writes only under .ui-tuning-lab/candidates/ in Application Support, atomically, never over an existing file
Loading stored candidates checks schemaVersion == 2 and platform == "ios"
Loading assigns to the draft, not to the captured baseline
The panel has Compare, Done, and the footer hint
The app typechecks in both DEBUG and Release configurations
